title: C1 Live Smoke: Folder-Based Job Scheduling Verification Paper

highwire_tags.citation_title: C1 Live Smoke: Folder-Based Job Scheduling Verification Paper
highwire_tags.citation_journal_title: Global Research Journal of Business Management
highwire_tags.citation_abstract:
Research Objective: This synthetic paper aims to verify the C1 folder-based jobs router end to end.

Methodology: The manuscript is placed into the new/publish folder of the project-root job folder and published through the jobs router CLI. The process includes filename parsing, metadata extraction, issue reservation, header and footer injection, DOCX to PDF conversion, R2 galley upload, frontend publication JSON push, and detached deployment confirmation.

Findings: The detached confirm process successfully verifies the live deployment.

Conclusion: The pipeline successfully processes the manuscript and deletes the source DOCX upon successful deployment.
